chunks: 997 - Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
"In the two sajdahs of forgetfulness, you say: In the Name of Allah and by Allah, and may Allah send blessings upon Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad."
He said: "And I heard him another time saying: In the Name of Allah and by Allah, peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings."

key_terms.السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ: a salutation addressed to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: in the Name of Allah; an opening invocation
key_terms.سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ: the two prostrations performed for forgetfulness in prayer
key_terms.وَبِاللَّهِ: by Allah; seeking reliance through Allah
key_terms.وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ: an invocation of Allah’s mercy and blessings
key_terms.وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ م: a formula of blessings upon Muḥammad and his family

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in the two prostrations of forgetfulness in prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the prescribed wording to be said in the two sajdahs of sahw in prayer. It shows two transmitted formulations, both beginning with invoking Allah and including salutation or blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.997 - Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:

"In the two prostrations of forgetfulness, you should say:
Bismillah wa billah, wa salla Allahu ‘ala Muhammad wa Aali Muhammad
In the name of Allah and by Allah, and may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

He said: "And I heard him say another time:
Bismillah wa billah, as-salamu ‘alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh
In the name of Allah and by Allah, peace be upon you, O’ Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.”
